nations.name: Kingdom of Valencious
nations.canon_note: Poster name Valencious; id and the Caldric culture unchanged. Caldrenn is the ruling dynasty (docs/regions/OWNER_DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-29).
nations.government_detail: A king rules from Kingsreach with a Council of Wardens (runestone keepers, marshals, the treasurer). Nobles hold land for service; village headmen answer to a noble or directly to the crown.
nations.notes: The runestone kingdom. Its frontier villages survive because the old stones keep monsters at bay; the crown's real power is who maintains them.

nations.name: Isles of Seirune
nations.government: sacred empress with a military regency
nations.government_detail: The Tide Empress is sacred and reigns but rarely rules. The Regent of the Sea Wall commands the great houses, which hold the islands as fiefs and keep sworn retainers.
nations.notes: Two warrior traditions serve the houses: the Oathblades fight openly under their house banner; the Veiled Lanterns are never seen at all.

nations.name: Ongur Khanate
nations.government_detail: Clan chiefs elect a Great Khan at the Summer Moot of Horses; a khan who loses battles or grazing can be voted out. Law is the spoken Code of the Grass.
nations.notes: The capital moves with the seasons. Caldrenn's northern marches have seen raids in hard winters.

nations.name: Aurelis Patriarchate (Church of the Dawn Throne)
nations.canon_note: Poster name Aurelis Patriarchate; id solmarch kept. Moved east: its pilgrims and envoys reach Valencious through the Eastern Gate. Vassal realms: Varska Marches and Serathi Lowlands (teaser_realms).
nations.government_detail: The Hierarch of the Undying Dawn rules through a synod of Flame-Bishops. Every town has a cathedral brazier that must never go out; tithes fund the Paladin Orders.
nations.notes: Solmarch preaches that monster races are 'unkindled' and must be purified. Its crusade against the orc clans has run for eleven years.

nations.name: Urrokai Clanlands
nations.government_detail: Each clan is ruled by its chief; the strongest chief is acclaimed Warchief at the Red Moon Moot. Disputes are settled by challenge. No written law.
nations.notes: Not all orcs follow the Warchief. Exiled clans like the Tuskridge have settled in Caldrenn's hills under an uneasy truce.

nations.name: Shenlu Peaks Covenant
nations.government_detail: There is no king. The Covenant Hall seats the masters of the great sects; the lowland towns pay tribute for protection and send their gifted children up the mountain.
nations.notes: Rumoured home of the last Drakari. The sects compete endlessly for disciples, spirit herbs and face.

nations.name: Veylwood Concord
nations.government_detail: Seven Grove Elders, each over three centuries old, decide by consensus. It can take them a decade to agree; in a crisis the Warden of Thorns acts alone.
nations.notes: The Veyl keep the old road to Xiava's Lake and decide who may walk it.

nations.name: Hollowdeep Holds
nations.government_detail: The Holds are run by the Hammer Moot: masters of the great forges and mine-guilds. The High Forgemaster is chosen by the finest masterwork of each generation.
nations.notes: Durrow steel reaches Ashford's smithy by caravan through Kingsreach, at a price.

_teaser_realms_doc: Realms that exist only as teasers in Region 1 (docs/regions/REGION_1_PLAN.md 1.7). Deliberately NOT in `nations`: no relations, factions or wars read them yet, and RAWorldLore requires every nation to be mutual with every other. `border` names the Region 1 site that points at them (RegionSites kind).

teaser_realms.name: Varska Marches
teaser_realms.hint: Pilgrim roads and watchfires beyond the Eastern Gate
teaser_realms.notes: March-lords of the Church: stern, fur-cloaked, loyal to the Dawn Throne.

teaser_realms.name: Serathi Lowlands
teaser_realms.hint: Terraced river country; the envoy's home
teaser_realms.notes: Soft-handed grain lords; Envoy Lucan of the Dawn Throne was born here.

teaser_realms.name: Solkar Dominion
teaser_realms.hint: Spice caravans come up the southern road each Midsummer
teaser_realms.notes: Desert traders; sunstone oil and saffron. Caravan mistress Imra Solvane speaks for them at Silverford.

teaser_realms.name: Frostcrown Holds
teaser_realms.hint: Grimfen Pass is snowed shut; frost-horned bones litter its throat
teaser_realms.notes: Hold-lords behind the pass. Nobody has come down Grimfen since the Long Dark.

teaser_realms.name: Umbrafen Marsh
teaser_realms.hint: Veyl rangers speak of a black fen beyond Westfen
teaser_realms.notes: A drowned country of lantern-folk; Veyl rangers of the Verdanweald watch its edge.
